extDescription.message: Download subtitles from YouTube, Netflix, Disney+ and any site as SRT, VTT, ASS or TXT.

folderHint.message: The folder chosen on the first download is remembered and reused when you reopen this window.

keepWindowOpen.message: Keep this window open until saving finishes. Files do not appear in Chrome's download list.

errFolderUnsupported.message: Chrome with direct folder saving support is required.

errFolderPermission.message: Write access to the selected folder is required. Try downloading again or change the folder.

noTracks.message: No subtitle tracks detected yet. Start playing the video, then press refresh.

noVideo.message: No video detected on this page.

universalHint.message: Grant access to all sites to detect subtitle files, HLS and DASH subtitle tracks loaded by any web player.

universalHintEnabled.message: Subtitle requests made by this page are listed below. Play the video with subtitles on if nothing appears.

universalEmpty.message: Nothing detected yet. Reload the page and play the video with subtitles enabled.

universalReloadHint.message: Detection enabled. Reload the page to capture subtitle requests.

errContentScript.message: The page must be reloaded after installing the extension.

errNetflixUrl.message: Could not obtain the subtitle URL from Netflix. Make sure the video is playing and try again.

errSegments.message: Subtitle segments could not be downloaded.
